about: The shell's fluidity budgets: the first load (fluid-15, fluid-20's bytes), Home (fluid-01), the inbox (fluid-02), the palette and search (fluid-13), Settings (fluid-14) and an overlay (fluid-16). surfaces.mjs --only shell on a production build against the fake server side, on a computer at 1x and a phone at 4x (FLUIDITY-LEAD, 20 Oct 2026).

measured is the median of 5 runs on beta 482460c3d. In-app opens go the way a person goes: the pointer rests 150 ms on a sidebar link (what IntentLink prefetches on) and clicks; a phone taps its tab bar.
Renders and bytes are enforced; times are printed against their max until they hold on a quiet P-core slot. Never raise a max to make a run pass.

firstLoadMs.source: A new tab, nothing cached, until Home shows what needs you or today's agenda. Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 654 at 1x on a computer (load 10 to 19), 2840 at 4x on a phone (load 19 to 38). Times above load 16 are inflated: provisional until a quiet rerun. Target: A new tab, nothing in memory: 1.0 s on a computer, 2.5 s on the 4x phone (chat programme Wave C, perf-mobile.md; Nielsen's 1 s limit for the flow of thought)

firstLoadKB.source: Script on the wire before Home is useful, KB as served (56 files). Beta 482460c3d on fixtures, 20 Oct 2026, P-cores, median of 5: 841 at 1x on a computer (load 10 to 19), 872 at 4x on a phone (load 19 to 38). Target: First-load script on the wire, KB: 450 KB (platform P-SPEED's target for Home and the project route, route-ceilings.json)

Target: Instant: an open or switch from cache within 100 ms on a computer (the brief's bar; Nielsen's 0.1 s limit for 'instantaneous'; RAIL's 100 ms response), and 300 ms on the 4x phone profile (the chat programme's later 4x target, perf-mobile.md)

firstLoadReadyKB.source: Script on the wire from a new tab's start until Home is useful: the first load's own, which P-SPEED's 450 KB is for. firstLoadKB adds the 2.5 s after it, where a page warms code once it is quiet (firstLoadWarmKB). Median of 5 quiet P-core runs on beta 354028322, 21 Oct 2026, load 0.1-2.7 (FLUIDITY-LEAD-2).
